notes.title: Patch 3-5-2024 has been released!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

I'm happy super excited to share with you a new patch for INSPIRE. Here are the patch notes.

Updates:

 Added Controller Support. NOTE: The game uses its own controller mapping system, so it's adviced to disable Steam Input for the game.
 Added a new critical hit system that triggers when in aiming mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972672/8aa66ce297f497c97801e0034b80dd4bce462855.png
While aiming, there's a chance that you perform a critical hit, doubling your damage.

 Increased the brightness of the night slightly. Shadows are now less dark at night. 
 Journal text improvements.
 Player items sell now for 50% less. No more selling used weapons for premium.
 Improved Quest flow of the Main Quest. Obelisk destruction is now required before being able to enter Mount Crater.
 Added a small light to the player to improve visibility when in dark areas.


Bugfixes:

 Improved ground detection, so player shooting is now more accurate, whilst also fixing an issue where the player would sometimes not shoot when on slopes.
 Various small performance fixes.


Make sure to update INSPIRE to the latest version, to experience these new additions/fixes.
And as always, if there's something you'd like to see changed, do let me know!

Thank you for playing the game and finding improvements and issues!

-Nick

notes.title: Patch 20-4-2024 has been released!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

I'm happy to share with you a new patch for INSPIRE. Here are the patch notes.

Make sure to update INSPIRE to the latest version, to experience these new additions/fixes.

notes.title: Patch 18-4-2024 has been released!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

I'm happy to share with you a new patch for INSPIRE. Here are the patch notes.

Updates:


Obelisk enemy spawners now spawn enemies dynamically in a radius around the player, instead of around the Obelisk. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972672/48a4479f50ad404cadef5c93f59f487021515d34.jpg
Above: Obelisk reinforcements.

 Removed the big rocks in Mount Crater, to help with better traversal and more engaging combat.
 Increased distance for Obelisk's AOE attack.
 Improved procedural animation navmesh detection & performance of all procedural creatures.
 Improved dynamic enemy wave spawners, which now have a max enemy amount treshold per spawner. Resulting in a more controllable behaviour per spawner, improving performance.
Improvements to the balancing of certain enemies.



Bugfixes:

Fixed an issue where the player would temporarily become invisible.
Fixed a couple of UI text issues.



Make sure to update INSPIRE to the latest version, to experience these new additions/fixes.

Thank you for playing the game and finding improvements and issues!

-Nick

notes.title: Patch 16-4-2024 has been released!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

I'm happy to share with you a new patch for INSPIRE. I managed to get quite a bit of updates and fixes done today so let me break them down for you in these patch notes:


Updates:

Added enemy resistance and weakness icons to the enemy health bars. The following damage types are in the game: Base,Fire,Frost,Poison & Electric. Red color means enemy has a resistance to that specific type. Green color means enemy has a weakness to that specific type. Resistance and Weakness is percentage based (0,50%), which is for you to figure out whilst playing :).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972672/ff328c0e81f756368911c23eff9d272562dc7680.png
Above: Enemy has a weakness against Fire and a Resistance against Poison.

Added health regeneration for Obelisks.
Improved the melee ability of the Behemoth which now has a slower but bigger area of effect.
Increased range of which the Behemoth does its melee ability.
Added health regeneration ability to appropriate enemies.
Increased drop rate of Life Cores.
Increased drop rate of Sentian Parts.
Improved "Alien Visitors" journal text.
Improved crafting menu tutorial text.
Improvements to various Sentian enemies' attack patterns & overall refinements.


Bugfixes:

Fixed an issue where the Behemoth doesn't damage the player with melee.
Fixed an issue where the Panther and Boar occasionally would damage themselves.
Implemented fixes to ensure consistent and accurate saving of credits.


I love seeing all of you play the game and I've got some exciting things in the works for INSPIRE. The first few weeks I'm focussing on tackling things that can be fixed/ improved upon rather quickly. After those are done I'll be looking into the more major fixes/improvements and updates for the game.

-Nick

notes.title: INSPIRE Patch 15-4-2024 has been released!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

So after watching a ton of gameplay from you(the good, bad, and the ugly), I've been working hard at improving the game.

Here are the patch notes for the latest patch.

Updates:

Added support for remapping WASD Movement.
Improved visibility of the shopkeepers in Realle.
Added direction signs towards vendors on appropriate floor tiles in Realle.
Added text to explain fast travel in the worldmap menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972672/f61adbb230eda9e5b75d8a498847bd44c7e52b7c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972672/93f01c8e5283b55714d301293abaf19f4507ae2c.png

Added a short cooldown to the look direction of the player after shooting with slow-firing weapons. Now the player's look direction doesn't go back and forth anymore when walking backwards and shooting with slow fire rates. 


Bugfixes:

Fixed an issue where the grenade launcher's projectiles would disable when off-screen.
Fixed an issue where the player could shoot when in dialogue.
Fixed an issue where the dead animals could still collide with alive animals.
Fixed an issue where animals who were retreating when they died, would do a sliding.

Thank you so much everyone for playing, and I will get these patches and updates out as soon as I can. Have a wonderful day everyone.

Best,

Nick
